content:
jordan: Heads up — after yesterday's client libs rollforward we’re seeing quota attribution drop for a subset of customers. console shows requests hitting the right model but bucket is `unknown` for ~3% of traffic. Investigating.
maria: Hmm, is this the header rename we landed in the proxy? `X-Route-Hint` -> `X-Rd-Route` ?
jordan: Yeah. The internal router accepts both, but the quota-service mapping code only reads the old header for a short path. SDKs shipped the new header and some old proxies send old header -> mismatch in hybrid setups.
sam: Oof. That would explain partial skew when requests go through edge A vs edge B. Can we hotfix quota service to fall back to the new header? quick patch?
jordan: I spun a patch locally: fallback order should be [`X-Rd-Route`, `X-Route-Hint`, `Route-Meta`]. Minimal change, low risk. But need to consider telemetry: we must not double-count when both headers exist.
maria: Right — dedupe rule: prefer the first non-empty header by whitelist order. Also add a metric `quota.attribution.header_mismatch` so we can see how often both headers are present.
lee: From SDK side, we can publish a 0.0.3 rollback for py/ts that restores the old header while we coordinate. But that would be another churn. Is a server-side fallback enough? :thinking:
jordan: Server fallback buys us time, but SDKs should emit a compatibility header for one week. For py client, example patch:
```python
# compatibility shim
headers['X-Rd-Route'] = headers.get('X-Rd-Route') or headers.get('X-Route-Hint')
```
We add a prominent log line on first use so we can track uptake.
ashley: Console UX question — when attribution is `unknown` we show a tooltip that suggests "routing header missing or unrecognized". If we flip fallback server-side, will that clear historical rows? We need a plan for backfilling dashboards / billing reports.
maria: Backfill options:
- Retro-run attribution for raw request logs for affected window (cheap, runs on parquet logs) -> best accuracy
- Mark affected rows as "recomputed" in console and show UTC range
I vote for retro-run for last 48 hours and present a change note in dashboard.
sam: Agree. We should gate backfill until we add the `quota.attribution.header_mismatch` metric so we can verify the scope. Also add a dry-run mode for patch that writes the computed attribution to a test column first.
ci-bot: deploy-started: quota-service/fallback-header-v1 -> canary on us-west-1 (job #8421)
lee: One more SDK concern: TS client uses a compact header encoding in tests; need to ensure we don't regress header casing normalization. Some proxies canonicalize to lowercase and some libs rely on exact case.
jordan: Good catch. Quota service already lowercases header names before lookup. But add an integration test in our proxy matrix: (gcp edge, aws alb, nginx) to assert both cases handled.
maria: OK action items: 1) jordan to land server fallback + metric (hotfix canary) 2) lee to cut py/ts compatibility patch with telemetry log 3) sam to schedule backfill job + dry-run 4) ashley to draft console note and indicate rows will flip after recompute.
jordan: I'll monitor canary and post updates here. If metric spikes >1% we pause and rollback. Thanks team :thumbsup:
ashley: tagging PMs for billing: @pm-billing — FYI, possible attribution corrections affecting last 48h on small set of tenants.
